findings.title: PROTOCOL.md's own state diagram still reads `rework (≤3)` and omits both reverify edges, while kernel.md's mirror diagram was updated to `≤N` plus the two edges
docs/specs/kernel.md:51 and :149 still enumerate orchid-task's verbs as `create/show/list/set/advance/unblock/retry`, without `reverify`

`retry` journals and appends operator guidance to the task body before calling `schedule_attempt_budget`, which can `orchid_die` on a misconfigured budget — the validate-before-mutate ordering `unblock` and `reverify` were explicitly given in this same change
